analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers around updating the firmware of [product_name] controllers, particularly moving from an older version to [version_no]. Users are concerned about process steps and compatibility with input expansion modules during the update. There is confusion regarding the benefits of the newer firmware, as well as a lack of clear, accessible update instructions and documentation. This leads to repeated questions and uncertainty among users attempting firmware upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easily accessible firmware download, clear documentation of the update procedure, a detailed explanation of new firmware advantages, and assurance that expansion modules will remain compatible after the update is completed.
